task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! First thing I need you to do is to look and see that the antique trunk is opened. After that, retrieve the old key from the antique trunk. Then, unlock the wooden door with the old key. Then, ensure that the wooden door is open. After opening the wooden door, head east. After that, open the screen door in the kitchen. And then, attempt to venture east. Following that, attempt to take a trip south. And then, retrieve the half of a bag of chips from the floor of the garden. With the half of a bag of chips, travel north. Then, try to go west. After that, place the half of a bag of chips on the stove inside the kitchen. Alright, thanks!
